_doc: ARCHETYPES (build styles). Cards, items and evolution-branch items carry 'tags' (archetype ids). RunState.synergy_counts() counts deck cards (1 each) and items (2 each) per archetype; a card/item whose tag count >= synergy_threshold is highlighted as a SYNERGY in drafts. Each archetype has payoff cards that scale with its own mechanics.

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.desc: Stay unspotted in tall grass; the first hit is free and hits hard (unaware bonus, Stalker, Mark).

bleed.name: Bleed
bleed.desc: Stack Bleed / Poison, then cash it in (Gore, Death Roll, Open Vein) or amplify it.

flank.name: Flank
flank.desc: Facing matters: strike from the side or back for big multipliers; cards and items that reward positioning.

speed.name: Tempo
speed.desc: Cheap fast cards, extra moves and turns; Momentum (tiles moved this turn) powers your attacks.

hitrun.name: Hit & Run
hitrun.desc: Strike, then retreat; use grass, water and evasion; Daze and Fear keep enemies off you.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.desc: Eat well: a good diet powers your cards (Savor, Ravenous Strike, Well-Fed) and items.
